facts.fact: AdWave's article states that modern CTV advertising starts at $50.
AdWave recommends allocating 20-30% of the marketing budget to awareness and brand building.
facts.quote: Allocate 20-30% of budget to awareness (not just conversion)

facts.fact: AdWave's suggested 2026 budget framework allocates 50-60% of budget to proven channels.
AdWave's suggested 2026 budget framework allocates 10-20% of budget to testing new channels or approaches.
AdWave's article describes a common small-business pattern of putting 80% or more of the marketing budget into Meta or Google as a problem to avoid.
facts.quote: 80%+ of your marketing budget goes to Meta or Google

facts.fact: AdWave describes a 30-second TV ad as a way to introduce a business and show what it sells.
facts.quote: A 30-second TV ad can introduce your business and show viewers what you sell.

facts.fact: Adwave states that its TV advertising service starts at $50 for businesses of any size, with AI-generated creative included.
facts.quote: Starting at $50, with AI-generated creative, you can be on TV before the year ends.

facts.fact: Adwave's page advises small businesses to plan for marketing spend of 5-10% of revenue, depending on growth goals.
facts.quote: Plan for 5-10% of revenue depending on your growth goals.

facts.fact: Adwave's page recommends testing one new marketing channel each quarter to prevent overwhelm.
facts.quote: Testing one new channel each quarter prevents overwhelm.
